propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust bounded request budget with zero incrementally banked verdicts rather than returning evidence-backed PASS/FAIL
Pydantic AI executes tool batches concurrently within a single response, allowing prompt-only serialization instructions to be bypassed and all record calls to be deferred until budget exhaustion
The completion contract requires each decided criterion to be banked incrementally so partial work survives, but zero-bank exhaustion violates this invariant

An explicit finite-banking policy wrapper must enforce one governed repository action per response and invoke provisional met=false recording on the third evidence response if the criterion remains unbanked

Simple three-criterion controls and five-criterion runs with system-level finite commit directives both bank successfully, isolating the defect to concurrent tool batching rather than schema/tool wiring
